summary: Iter 63 — Website Builder one-click publish + custom domain end-to-end testing complete. All 4 new backend endpoints verified via pytest (10/10 passed). Frontend publish-first DomainIntentCard flow on /portal/website-builder works end-to-end with real Claude generation: chip → generate → preview → publish (success card with public URL, visit, copy, toggle) → connect-domain (DNS instructions with CNAME + A/ALIAS rows). Public /p/:slug route renders brand/hero/CTAs and the lead form posts successfully (published-lead-success shown). Homepage hero copy update is live with both 'Your Business Doesn't Need Another CRM' and 'Execution, Automation' phrases, and is responsive at 390px (no horizontal overflow).
critical_code_review_comments: business_builder.py is 821 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting publish/lead/connect-domain endpoints into a dedicated /backend/publish_routes.py module for readability.

POST /website-publish does not authenticate the caller — anyone can publish arbitrary site JSON to a slug. Acceptable for current MVP, but slug squatting is possible (unique-resolved with hex suffix, so not a hard collision DoS, but worth tracking).

GET /published/{slug} returns visit_count = stored+1 instead of re-reading after $inc — minor, but the returned count won't match a subsequent admin query if multiple visits land in parallel (race-tolerant by design).
ConnectDomainReq validates shape with regex `^[a-z0-9.\-]+\.[a-z]{2,}$`. Accepts 'a.b.c.d' and 'sub.under_score-ok.com' but not IDN/punycode; OK for an MVP.
Lead form on /p/:slug only requires email-or-phone server-side; consider also rejecting obviously bogus emails (regex) — currently 'foo@bar' would slip through `'@' in email` check.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all flows: publish, connect-domain, public site, lead form, hero copy, mobile)

test_credentials: N/A — all new endpoints are public
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed published_sites docs during pytest run (slugs prefixed test-publish-/test-collide-/test-fetch-/test-lead-/test-domain-). One real Claude-generated site was published via UI: slug=sarah-lopez-realty.

Public URLs return SITE_URL absolute https URLs. visit_count increments correctly. Slug collision auto-resolves with 5-hex suffix. Hero copy on HomePage.jsx (lines ~379-380) verified with new enterprise positioning.
